title: EntitySourceAction
responsibility: Opens a selected owned source file through the authorized Desktop bridge.

inputs.name: EntitySourceAction.entity
inputs.description: Entity identity and optional detail source paths.

inputs.name: EntitySourceAction.workspace
inputs.description: Authorized bridge, project context and selected revision.

inputs.name: EntitySourceAction.path
inputs.description: The owned file selected by this row; its contents appear first in the modal.

outputs.name: EntitySourceAction
outputs.description: A file-specific View code button. Opening retains the selected commit and address; closing restores focus to this row.
